rows.note: Use this as the all-purpose choice before a time expression, such as 下個星期 or 下個月, including dates like next Tuesday.

example.jyutping: haa6 go3 sing1 kei4 ngo5 dei6 heoi3 leoi5 hang4

rows.note: Use this for the next item or person in a sequence, meaning “the next one.”

example.english: When we are lining up, you are next.
example.jyutping: paai4 deoi6 go3 zan6 haa6 jat1 go3 dou3 nei5

rows.note: Use this when the next item in the sequence is an occasion or event, meaning “next time.”

example.english: Next time, I will treat you to dinner.
example.jyutping: haa6 jat1 ci3 ngo5 ceng2 nei5 sik6 faan6

rows.note: This is the all-purpose casual choice for what follows next in a sequence or on a subsequent occasion.

example.jyutping: gan1 zyu6 ngo5 dei6 zau6 heoi3 sik6 faan6

rows.note: Use this for the next item, person, or position in an ordered sequence, not for the next occasion.

example.jyutping: haa6 jat1 go3 man6 tai4 hai6 mat1 je5

rows.note: Use this for the next occasion or next time something happens.

example.english: Next time, remember to say it earlier.
example.jyutping: haa6 ci3 gei3 zyu6 zou2 di1 gong2
